invariants.rationale: If b==0, the method returns Integer.MIN_VALUE; otherwise, it returns the division result.
If b is not zero, the method returns the integer division of a by b.
If b==0, result need not equal a/b, but if not, it must be a/b.
If b==0, result is Integer.MIN_VALUE; otherwise, this is vacuously true.
If b==0, ensures that a is within range; always true, but relates a to the control logic.
